name: Orchard Exchange
description: Harvest, eat, and settle reciprocal stock-backed barter in a living orchard.
natural_language: Keep yourself fed. Harvest apples, match nearby farmers’ barter offers, and deliver the requested basket at the striped stall.

metadata.notes: Independent farmers harvest bananas, eat preferentially apples, and post stock-dependent terms. Transfers require reciprocal offers, radius and solvency.
